verdict.rationale: GitLab documents its own credential mechanisms: personal access tokens and OAuth 2.0 bearer credentials for the API. Duo Agent Platform activity is attributed to a dedicated service account (composite identity), which gives agents a distinct identity. However, nothing in the pack shows these credentials can be limited by scope, permission level, resource or expiry for least-privilege agent use. Missing for 10: documented token scopes or permission restriction, per-agent least-privilege credential issuance, token expiry or rotation controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
